mega_retentions_2025._note: The players each franchise retained at the 2025 mega auction, capped or uncapped AT RETENTION (31 Oct 2024), in the order of the published list. Under the 2025-27 rules each is charged to the purse by the retention slabs while he stays with that franchise (`retained_cost = "slabs"` in config/competitions.toml; web_parity/keep.py `slab_charge`). A traded player (Samson, Jadeja) is charged his salary at his new team. Harshit Rana, Ramandeep Singh and Mayank Yadav's status is as at retention: Harshit and Ramandeep were capped only in Nov 2024, so they took uncapped slots; Mayank Yadav had debuted (Oct 2024), so he took a capped one. Check: max(slab total, salary total) reproduces every team's published 2025 purse (RR 41, SRH 45, MI 45, KKR 51, CSK 55, GT 69, LSG 69, DC 73, RCB 83, PBKS 110.5).
mega_retentions_2025._source: Retained lists and salaries: Wikipedia, 'List of 2025 Indian Premier League personnel changes' (data/curated/ipl_auction_history.json); purses: Rajasthan Royals, 2024-11-21, https://www.rajasthanroyals.com/latest-news/indian-premier-league-2025-mega-auction-ipl-teams-remaining-purse ; slabs: ESPNcricinfo, 2024-09-28, https://africa.espn.com/cricket/story/_/id/41492797/ipl-2025-auction-retention-rules-six-retentions-per-team-right-match-returns-impact-player-stay

purse_check_2026._after_auction_note: Purse left after the 2026 auction for the four teams that don't reconcile from salaries alone, as tabulated by Business Standard ('IPL 2026 Auction: Remaining purse, retained players list of all 10 teams', https://www.business-standard.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-2026-auction-remaining-purse-retained-players-list-of-all-10-teams-125121500242_1.html; read through a search index on 2026-10-22, the site refuses automated fetches). Published pre-auction purse less our auction prices gives exactly these four figures, so the auction prices are right and the gap is on the retained side.
purse_check_2026._note: Each team's purse entering the 2026 auction as published (125 cr less the retained salaries), to check the salaries above: `cricdex keep --check` compares them.
purse_check_2026._slab_note: What the purse counts beyond the salaries, per team (cr). In the 2025 mega auction a retained player was charged to the purse at a fixed slab (capped: 18 / 14 / 11 / 18 / 14 cr for the 1st-5th, uncapped 4 cr) 'regardless of the final retention value' (DNA India, 2024-11-03), so KKR paid 57 cr in salaries but lost 69 cr of purse. The published 2026 figures are reproduced exactly when each 2025 retention still on the squad is charged at his slab, not his salary: KKR +6 (Rinku 13 / Varun 12 / Narine 12 at 18 / 14 / 11; Russell's 18 freed), DC +3.25 (Axar, Kuldeep, Stubbs: 39.75 cr of salary on 43 cr of slabs), CSK +2 (Gaikwad + Dube charged 32 against 30 of salary), RR +4 (Jaiswal, Parag, Jurel, Hetmyer charged 61 against 57; Samson's slab was 14). Inferred from the published totals: the IPL doesn't publish each player's slab, so the per-player split for CSK and RR is not known; the team totals are exact.
